result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice with a refund of prepaid post-termination fees and no penalty, while Kubient cannot terminate for convenience mid-term and may exit only at term-end on 90 days’ notice. However, permitting termination of “any Exhibit,” “in whole or in part,” goes beyond what the playbook requires and may override exhibit-specific commitments. Drafting is generally clear but should avoid that unnecessary expansion and correct the comma splice before paragraph (b).
